subject: Request to extend demo window while AP completes review
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@wellnova.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@wellnova.com
Date: Sat, 5 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request to extend demo window while AP completes review

Hi Logan,

Quick note from procurement/finance at WellNova — our AP team put the PO through an extra compliance step yesterday (vendor onboarding verification) and they expect the review to finish in ~10 business days. Our pilot is in the middle of end-to-end tests and we’re worried the demo timer will expire before AP clears the PO.

Can Redwood keep our sandbox/demo active for another two weeks (14 days) while AP finishes? If helpful, I can share the PO status snapshot and the procurement ticket. We want to avoid losing the evaluation momentum.

Thanks for understanding — happy to provide any paperwork procurement needs.

Best,
Elena Torres
Senior Program Manager, Partnerships
WellNova Health
[Attachment: WellNova_PO_Status.pdf (application/pdf) - 212KB]

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@wellnova.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 5 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to extend demo window while AP completes review

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and for the PO status. We definitely want to keep the pilot live while your AP team finishes the review.

I can approve a 14-day extension immediately, subject to a short confirmation from our finance operations team (standard tracker entry). To make this quick, I’ll route a temporary agreement (14-day demo extension + 20k token supplement) and confirm once it’s applied to your account.

Can you confirm the expected completion date for AP (even a rough ETA) and whether procurement needs an invoice/MAA before we apply the extension?

Next steps:
- I’ll loop in our commercial lead (Marissa) to finalize the temporary agreement.
- If procurement needs a DocuSign link, I’ll send it along.

Logan Wright
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Cell: (555) 408-1192
[Attachment: temporary-14day-extension.pdf (application/pdf) - 18KB]

https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?po=abcdef123456

Best,
